recipes.name: Sun-Dried Tomato & Butter Bean Stew
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Cook the leek for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the garlic, thyme, and rosemary. Cook for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the sun-dried tomatoes and flour. Continue to stir, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the water and bouillon cube. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook uncovered until thickened.
Stir in the beans and cooking cream. Cook for another 2 minutes.
Lastly, stir in the spinach, white wine vinegar and black pepper.
Serve with toasted bread, garnish, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Also known as lima beans.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
